//: Budgets set for a mid-range Android on island 4G, not a laptop on fibre. The traveller this product is for has a Moto G-class phone and 0.5-3 Mbps, so a budget met on a MacBook proves nothing.

assert.//: MEASURED, not aspirational. On this profile (4x CPU slowdown, 1.6 Mbps, roughly a Moto G4 on slow 4G) the feed lands at LCP 3.0s and perf 94 across three runs; the budget sits just above with headroom. That profile is deliberately harsher than the p75 the 2.5s 'good' threshold is defined against, so this is not a 2.5s failure -- it is a stricter test than the standard one. Measured total transfer is 455 KB (298 script, 90 font), hence the 600 KB ceiling: it catches hls.js if it ever stops being lazy. Keys inside `assertions` are audit NAMES, so a comment key is read as an audit that did not run -- notes live here. SEO is off because robots.txt disallows everything until NEXT_PUBLIC_ALLOW_INDEXING flips at the cutover.
